svg.aria-label: Visual Product Search: Instant retrieval of gold design records from a rough photo or SKU code, orchestrating a multi-model computer-vision pipeline built for accuracy and low latency at scale. | AI Security Intelligence: Facial recognition plus a generative video-understanding model on NVIDIA edge hardware, verifying security-check compliance in real time. Built with an external technology firm.
